kind: compiled extension with fake VS Code API and real Python subprocess pipes

observations.name: two statement evaluations populate one Python session
clear removes recordings but preserves variables and input replay
selection evaluation never resets even with resetOnLoad on
help reads settings without a Python request or command execution
whole-file reset off preserves bindings across files and input replay
restart discards variables and replay while recorded answers remain
clear input answers forgets replay only
whole-file reset on discards old bindings and saved answers
script resets even with setting off and ignores selection
above-cursor resets variables and replay, leaving cursor statement unrun
